senses.exPt: A temperatura caiu para cinco graus ontem à noite.

senses.def: a person who leaves school or college before finishing
senses.ex: He was a high school dropout, but he became a famous chef.
senses.exPt: Ele largou os estudos no ensino médio, mas virou um chef famoso.

senses.def: a long period with little or no rain
senses.ex: The long drought destroyed most of the crops.
senses.exPt: A longa seca destruiu a maior parte das plantações.

senses.def: to die because you are under water and cannot breathe
senses.ex: He nearly drowned in the river when he was a child.
senses.exPt: Ele quase se afogou no rio quando era criança.

senses.def: an illegal substance that people take to feel different
senses.ex: He went to prison for selling drugs.
senses.exPt: Ele foi preso por vender drogas.

senses.def: a medicine
senses.ex: This new drug can help people with heart problems.
senses.exPt: Este novo remédio pode ajudar pessoas com problemas no coração.

senses.def: a shop that sells medicine and things like soap and shampoo
senses.ex: I need to stop at the drugstore on the way home.
senses.exPt: Preciso passar na farmácia no caminho de casa.

senses.def: a set of drums played by one person in a band
senses.ex: My son plays the drums in a rock band.
senses.exPt: Meu filho toca bateria numa banda de rock.

senses.def: a round musical instrument that you hit with your hands or sticks
senses.ex: The little boy was beating a toy drum.
senses.exPt: O menininho batia num tambor de brinquedo.

senses.def: not able to think or act normally because of drinking alcohol
senses.ex: He was too drunk to drive home.
senses.exPt: Ele estava bêbado demais para dirigir até em casa.

senses.def: without water or liquid
senses.ex: Make sure your hair is dry before you go out.
senses.exPt: Veja se o seu cabelo está seco antes de sair.

senses.def: to remove the water from something
senses.ex: Dry your hands with this towel.
senses.exPt: Enxugue as mãos com esta toalha.

senses.def: a bird that lives near water and swims
senses.ex: The children fed the ducks at the lake.
senses.exPt: As crianças deram comida aos patos no lago.

senses.def: an informal word for a man, or for talking to a friend
senses.ex: Hey dude, are you coming to the party tonight?
senses.exPt: E aí, cara, você vai na festa hoje à noite?

senses.def: expected to happen or arrive at a certain time
senses.ex: The next train is due in five minutes.
senses.exPt: O próximo trem está previsto para daqui a cinco minutos.

senses.def: when something must be paid or given in
senses.ex: The rent is due on the fifth of every month.
senses.exPt: O aluguel vence todo dia cinco.

senses.def: due to: because of
senses.ex: The game was cancelled due to rain.
senses.exPt: O jogo foi cancelado devido à chuva.

senses.def: a formal fight between two people, or any contest between two sides
senses.ex: The two men fought a duel at dawn.
senses.exPt: Os dois homens travaram um duelo ao amanhecer.

senses.def: boring; not interesting or exciting
senses.ex: The lesson was so dull that I almost fell asleep.
senses.exPt: A aula foi tão chata que eu quase dormi.

senses.def: not bright, especially about the weather or sky
senses.ex: It was a dull, grey morning.
senses.exPt: Foi uma manhã nublada e cinzenta.

senses.def: not bright or shiny, about colours or surfaces
senses.ex: The paint looks dull after so many years.
senses.exPt: A tinta parece sem brilho depois de tantos anos.

senses.def: stupid (informal)
senses.ex: Sorry, I know that was a dumb question.
senses.exPt: Desculpa, eu sei que foi uma pergunta idiota.

senses.def: to get rid of something you don't want, often carelessly
senses.ex: The factory was dumping waste into the river.
senses.exPt: A fábrica estava despejando lixo no rio.

senses.def: informal: to suddenly end a romantic relationship with someone
senses.ex: She dumped her boyfriend after two weeks.
senses.exPt: Ela terminou com o namorado depois de duas semanas.

senses.def: a place where people take rubbish
senses.ex: We took the old furniture to the dump.
senses.exPt: Levamos os móveis velhos para o lixão.

senses.def: something that is an exact copy of something else
senses.ex: Keep a duplicate of the key in a safe place.
senses.exPt: Guarde uma cópia da chave em um lugar seguro.

senses.def: doing or copying something that has already been done
senses.ex: We need to avoid duplication of work between the two teams.
senses.exPt: Precisamos evitar a duplicação de trabalho entre as duas equipes.

senses.def: able to last a long time without breaking or getting damaged
senses.ex: These hiking boots are made of very durable leather.
senses.exPt: Estas botas de trilha são feitas de um couro muito resistente.

senses.def: the length of time that something lasts
senses.ex: Please stay in your seats for the duration of the flight.
senses.exPt: Por favor, permaneçam sentados durante toda a duração do voo.

senses.def: from the beginning to the end of a period of time
senses.ex: I fell asleep during the film.
senses.exPt: Eu dormi durante o filme.

senses.def: very small pieces of dry dirt
senses.ex: The old books were covered in dust.
senses.exPt: Os livros velhos estavam cobertos de poeira.

senses.def: a large container for rubbish, usually kept outside a house
senses.ex: Please throw the old food in the dustbin.
senses.exPt: Por favor, jogue a comida velha na lata de lixo.

senses.def: covered with dust
senses.ex: We found some old books in a dusty box.
senses.exPt: Encontramos uns livros velhos numa caixa empoeirada.

senses.def: doing everything you are expected to do, out of duty
senses.ex: She was a dutiful daughter who visited her mother every day.
senses.exPt: Ela era uma filha dedicada que visitava a mãe todos os dias.

senses.def: doing what you are told or expected to do
senses.ex: The students dutifully copied everything from the board.
senses.exPt: Os alunos copiaram direitinho tudo o que estava no quadro.

senses.def: something you must do because it is right or the law
senses.ex: It's your duty to tell the police what you saw.
senses.exPt: É seu dever contar à polícia o que você viu.

senses.def: a task that is part of your job
senses.ex: Her duties include answering the phone and booking meetings.
senses.exPt: As funções dela incluem atender o telefone e marcar reuniões.

senses.def: a tax you pay on things you buy or bring into a country
senses.ex: There is a high duty on imported cars.
senses.exPt: Há um imposto alto sobre carros importados.

senses.def: bought without paying tax, usually at an airport
senses.ex: You can buy duty-free perfume at the airport.
senses.exPt: No aeroporto, dá para comprar perfume livre de impostos.

senses.def: a shop at an airport where you can buy goods without tax
senses.ex: I bought this perfume at the duty-free before my flight.
senses.exPt: Comprei este perfume no free shop antes do voo.

senses.def: a large soft cover filled with feathers, used on a bed
senses.ex: It's cold tonight, so I'll use the thick duvet.
senses.exPt: Está frio hoje, então vou usar o edredom grosso.

senses.def: a small creature like a man in children's stories
senses.ex: The story is about a dwarf who lives under a mountain.
senses.exPt: A história é sobre um anão que mora embaixo de uma montanha.

senses.def: a substance used to change the colour of hair, cloth and so on
senses.ex: She bought some red hair dye at the pharmacy.
senses.exPt: Ela comprou uma tinta de cabelo vermelha na farmácia.

senses.def: to change the colour of something using a dye
senses.ex: She dyed her hair blonde for the summer.
senses.exPt: Ela pintou o cabelo de loiro para o verão.

senses.def: full of energy and new ideas; always changing
senses.ex: She is a dynamic young manager full of ideas.
senses.exPt: Ela é uma gerente jovem e dinâmica, cheia de ideias.

senses.def: in a way that changes all the time, or with energy
senses.ex: The website updates prices dynamically based on demand.
senses.exPt: O site atualiza os preços dinamicamente de acordo com a demanda.

senses.def: a family of rulers who rule a country for a long time
senses.ex: The dynasty ruled China for almost three hundred years.
senses.exPt: A dinastia governou a China por quase trezentos anos.
